marks.gloss_en: לא תבערו אש, מה ת״ל? kindling was in the general rule and singled out to equate the rest to it: as kindling is an av melacha liable by itself, so every av melacha is liable by itself
(entertained) one might think: if he did them all in one lapse of awareness he is liable only once
מאי טעמא דרבי יוסי: אחת / מאחת, הנה / מהנה -- the verse's doubled forms yield one that is many and many that are one, hence sometimes once for all and sometimes for each
R' Yosei: 'and does from one of these' (Lev 4:2) -- sometimes one is liable once for all, and sometimes for each one
Shmuel: the source of the division of labours is 'its desecrators shall surely die' (Ex 31:14) -- the Torah multiplied deaths for one desecration
R' Natan: 'devarim', 'hadevarim', 'eleh hadevarim' (Ex 35:1) -- these are the thirty-nine labours stated to Moses at Sinai
kindling was singled out [to be] a [mere] prohibition
אמר ליה רב נחמן: כלום פריש משבת אלא משום מלאכות -- does he desist on account of Shabbat for any reason but the labours?
וכלום פריש ממלאכות אלא משום שבת -- and does he desist from the labours for any reason but Shabbat?
Rav Safra: here [the רישא] it is from awareness of Shabbat that he desists
